answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 361 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the lotus. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the oasis queue while genuine members promoted earlier still earns. The haven index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 494 account operation therefore ties up 22 million dollars of idle capital. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
